steps.instruction: Distinguish internal provider setup from the external client's own provider. Never collect credentials in chat.

If there is no project yet or the matching Editor is missing, read references/zero-start.md in the current chat. Inspect the host, any requested project version, and available templates. For an existing connection problem, diagnose the affected layer.

steps.when: The requested setup needs missing host software.
steps.instruction: Use the permitted host tools to download and install the international Unity Hub, exact global Unity Editor, and VCC or ALCOM if a manager is needed. Verify each installed product and follow existing installer processes. Resume after any required personal interaction. A download-only request ends at the verified file.

Register or select the intended existing project. For a requested first project, create it in the agreed location with a matching installed template. If none is available, use the chosen manager's project creation flow and register the resulting project root.
Open the selected project if closed, then follow its Editor through package resolution and compilation. Reuse a starting instance.

steps.manualAlternative: Only when this client has no tool that can install Core, import the matching VRCForge.unitypackage in the selected Unity window.

steps.instruction: Preserve pending status. Diagnose actual errors before a repair; do not repeat an in-progress install.

steps.when: The original request requires an Avatar.
steps.instruction: Require matching project/instance, complete tools and settled compilation before resuming the user's edit request.

completionScope: For a connection request, verify the items below. For a download-only request, finish at delivery of the verified installer file.

entryModes.first_run: Choose internal AI or an external client, then verify that route before project setup.
entryModes.daily_repair: Preserve the working configuration and current task; diagnose the failing layer, repair only what evidence requires, then retry and resume.
